About

Smith joinery is a small company that takes pride in any job. From hanging a door to building a new house. Through out my apprenticeship I was taught to do a job as if it was in my own home and still carry that tradition to this day. No need to hesitate to contact if the job is straight forward or bespoke to your needs. I am also on fifes trusted trader and on Facebook smith joinery
